column1: On 19 September 2019, Amazon and Global Optimism announced The
Climate Pledge, a commitment to meet the Paris Agreement 10 years early.
Amazon is the first signatory of this pledge. The Climate Pledge calls on
signatories to be net zero carbon across their businesses by 2040 – a decade
ahead of the Paris Agreement’s goal of 2050.
